batting.name: JP Inglis
batting.dismissal: c SV Samson b J Overton

batting.name: MR Marsh
batting.dismissal: c D Brevis b A Kamboj

batting.name: N Pooran
batting.dismissal: c SN Khan b Noor Ahmad

batting.name: Akshat Raghuwanshi
batting.dismissal: c Urvil Patel b J Overton

batting.name: Urvil Patel
batting.dismissal: c Avesh Khan b Shahbaz Ahmed

batting.name: Kartik Sharma
batting.dismissal: c Akshat Raghuwanshi b Avesh Khan

balls.text: Shahbaz finishes off the innings in style! Thigh-high full toss wide outside off. Shahbaz walks across his stumps and whacks it over wide long on. Shahbaz has reviewed, arguing it should be a No ball and starts trudging off soon after. Pretty sure this is not going to be a No ball. Shahbaz's body language suggests as much. Shahbaz's waist is measured at 1.02m, with the ball passing at 0.78m. LSG finish with 203!

chaos all around, and Shami is run out! Dug into the track just outside leg. Shami swings for the hills and misses. Shahbaz calls him through for the single, and Shami is very late to react. Samson throws it to Kamboj, who collects it and then takes off the bails with Shami stranded!

sizzling yorker, and Kamboj goes past Rabada to reclaim the Purple Cap! Zinged in very full on leg. Himmat shuffles across, perhaps anticipating the wide yorker. Tries to jam it out but only nutmegs himself in the process. Kamboj his thrilled - he has outthought the batter here, and LSG now seven down!

sliced up, and Overton puts down an absolute soda! Banged in short outside off. Shahbaz has a wild mow at it and gets it all wrong. Overton settles under it at extra cover and the ball slips through his fingers. Overton has his hand up in apology!
into the blockhole outside off and Shahbaz cannot do much with it. Tries to go inside-out and chunks it off the inside edge into his body
shortish on off. Shahbaz winds up and hoicks it towards deep square leg. Shahbaz has enough time to race back for two
slower ball hung up full and wide. Shahbaz drags it to mid on and scampers across to the other end. Might have copped a throw on the body for his troubles too
angled across full outside off. Shahbaz has a slog at it and only connects with fresh air
more runs! Short again and this is a cutter too. Shahbaz throws the lot at it and slices it between the keeper and short third!
sharp short ball, finishing just outside off. Shahbaz has a swipe at it and cloths it over the bowler's head. Back for a couple of runs
Shahbaz goes all the way now! Back of a length outside off but Shahbaz has this lined up. He stands tall and hoists it over mid off!
short, wide and put away! Too much width on offer and Shahbaz throws the kitchen sink at it, slashing it over backward point!
low full toss just outside off. Shahbaz gets down on one knee and paddles it towards short fine leg. Dube misfields and Shahbaz can keep strike
into the blockhole on middle and leg. Shahbaz scuffs it back to the bowler
very full and very wide outside off. Himmat does well to reach it but chalks it towards extra cover
looks for the wide yorker but errs on the line aspect. Well beyond the tramlines and called a wide
very full on off. Shahbaz cannot get under this and digs it out towards sweeper cover
up, up and away! Low full toss on middle and leg. Shahbaz bends his back knee, gets under it and shovels it over deep backward square leg!
right up in the blockhole on middle and off. Shahbaz jams down on it and keeps it out
shot! Back of a length outside off and Himmat thrives on the width. He frees his arms and slaps it past extra cover!
full outside off. Shahbaz reaches out for it and drives it towards sweeper cover
shortish just outside off. Himmat gets up on his toes and tugs it towards deep mid wicket
into the blockhole outside off. Shahbaz cannot get under it and clinks it towards extra cover
banged half-way down again, outside off. Shahbaz looks for the upper-cut but is a touch late on it
slower ball on a full length on off. Himmat comes onto the front foot and knocks it to long on

big lbw shout, but this might have been sliding down leg! Googly on a length on middle and leg. Shahbaz gets caught on the crease and plays all around it. Seemed to be spinning too much but CSK want to chance their luck. No bat involved, and Ball Tracking reckons the ball would have only clipped leg stump. Umpire's Call, and Shahbaz stays!
flighted up full outside leg. Himmat lunges forward and prods it into the mid wicket region
fired in on a length on middle and off. Himmat sits back in his crease and defends
back of a length just outside off. Shahbaz goes back and turns it behind square
full toss on the pads. Himmat punches it crisply between long on and deep mid wicket, and Brevis has to tumble to his left to save a run
googly on a back of a length outside off. Himmat hangs back and dabs it behind point

borderline waist-high full toss outside off. Shahbaz has a swipe at it and shanks it to mid off. Seemed a little too high and Shahbaz has reviewed it. This could be a No ball. Shahbaz's waist is measured at 1.02m but the ball is passing through at 0.94. No ball not called!
back of a length on middle and leg. Himmat a tad late on the flick and the ball rolls off his thigh pad behind square on the leg side
pick the bones out of that one! Half-tracker outside off and this sits up nicely. Himmat spots the length early, swivels and belts it over deep backward square leg!
welcomes the new batter with a bumper. On leg and Himmat is happy to duck under it

spliced to mid off, and Overton is making Chepauk his stage again! Hard length outside off. Raghuwanshi looks to pop it downtown but cannot quite get on top of the bounce. Off the higher part of the blade and Urvil completes the most regulation of catches. LSG's slide continues!
shortish and sliding down leg. Raghuwanshi swings at it and misses. Called a wide

Samson is interested, but no support from Overton! Dug in short just outside off. Raghuwanshi shapes for the upper-cut and seems to miss it. Samson thought there was bat involved, but was not convinced enough to ask his skipper for a review.
oh! Back of a length in the channel and this skids through. A bit of inward seam movement too and Shahbaz, trying to dab it away, is beaten on the inside
length ball on middle and off. Raghuwanshi punches it to long on
shot! Length ball outside off. Raghuwanshi marches down the track and flays it past extra cover. Much-needed momentum for LSG!
shortish outside off. Raghuwanshi rides the bounce and runs it down to deep third, where Dube fumbles and concedes an extra run
length outside off. Shahbaz gets onto the front foot and drives it on the up towards sweeper cover
fullish on middle and leg. Raghuwanshi plants his front foot and drives it back to the bowler, who gets a hand to it and diverts it towards mid off
short, wide and punished! Enough width on offer for Shahbaz and he rocks back to knife it behind point!
back of a length outside off. Raghuwanshi punches it off the back foot towards long off
darted in full just outside off. Shahbaz comes forward and turns it into the mid wicket region
back of a length on middle and leg. Raghuwanshi lets the ball come to him before stabbing it into the mid wicket region
fired in on a length outside off. Raghuwanshi steps out and pushes it to extra cover. Sets off for a non-existent run and gets sent back. Regains his ground in time

a direct hit from the deep, and Markram might be outta here! DB with a moment of absolute fielding magic! Flighted up very full just outside off. Raghuwanshi tugs it to long on's right and the call is for two. Markram has to rush, though, and Brevis is sharp - both with his pick-up and then with his throw. Rifles a throw at the stumps, and Markram is gone for all money. LSG five down, and CSK on the prowl!
short and wide outside off. Raghuwanshi hangs back and slaps it towards extra cover, where Brevis sprawls to his left and stops the boundary
googly on a length on off. Markram stretches forward and pushes it to long on
slanted in on a back of a length on middle and leg. Raghuwanshi plays all over it and the ball bobbles off his pad into the off side
length outside off. Markram goes back and jabs it towards sweeper cover
back of a length outside off. Dabbed off the back foot towards short third
back of a length, angling into the pads. Markram eases it out to deep mid wicket
back of a length just outside off. Raghuwanshi plays it off the back foot towards extra cover
pushed in on a length on off. Markram stays back and punches it to long on
tossed up on a length on middle and off. Raghuwanshi drops it into the off side and dashes across to the other end
back of a length on the pads. Raghuwanshi glances it past short fine leg and has enough time to saunter back for a brace
back of a length on the stumps. Markram stabs it into the leg side
flighted up full on leg. Raghuwanshi comes forward and knocks it to long on
back of a length on middle and off. Markram rises with the bounce and pats it gently towards mid wicket
back of a length just outside off. Raghuwanshi rises with the bounce and drops it into the off side
jammed in full but well down leg. Raghuwanshi misses it and the umpire has no qualms in calling it a wide

chopped on, and Overton is absolutely pumped! The whistles turned up a notch, and LSG are now four down! Hard length on middle and leg, and this seems to gather pace after pitching. Pant has a loose poke at it and the ball cannons off the inside edge into his stumps. Overton has brought the crowd to life, and Pant walks back after a scratchy knock!

back of a length on middle and off. Pant turns it into the square leg region. A breakdown in communication ensues and had Noor hit the stumps at the bowler's end, Markram would have been a mile short. Could Overton have gotten back to the stumps too?
back of a length on middle and leg. Markram hops up onto his toes and tucks it off his hips behind square

Inglis fluffs the scoop, and Overton has his man! Shortish outside off and Inglis looks for that favoured scoop of his. Gets across his stumps and gets a nick too but it is not enough to beat Samson to his left. Sharp grab by the keeper, and Overton has answered CSK prayers again. Take nothing away from this sensational knock, though!
a little ungainly, but it will do for Pant and LSG! Dragged down on off. Pant opens up his stance and muscles it between deep mid wicket and deep backward square leg!
back of a length just outside off. Pant goes back and nudges it between deep mid wicket and deep backward square leg for a brace
dragged down on middle and off. Inglis hops back and hoicks it on the bounce to deep mid wicket
short and wide outside off. Inglis hops back and jabs it straight to cover, much to his disappointment
leg-spinner on a back of a length, following the batter outside leg. Inglis looks to cut but has no room to work with. Cut in half in the end
brilliant, just brilliant! Seems like a googly, pushed through full on middle and leg. Inglis backs away, gets his hands through the ball and lofts it over cover!
slower ball on a fullish length outside off. Pant shuffles across, gets himself into a tangle and ends up blocking it back to the bowler
shortish just outside off, and this zings through too. Pant has a half-hearted swipe at it and is beaten for pace
more luck for Pant! Hard length on middle and off, and this zips through. Pant looks to dab it behind point but instead, squirts it off the inside edge past the keeper!
slower full toss just outside off. Inglis has a pop at it and chunks it towards mid on for a quick single
another short ball outside off and this gets big on Pant. He tugs it one-handed towards deep mid wicket. Inglis is intent on the second and gets sent back from half-way. No damage done, though
banged in short on middle and off. Inglis gets on top of the bounce and pulls it behind square. Kamboj does well to mop it up on the fence, having run to his right
oh! Googly fizzed through on a back of a length outside off. Skids through and Pant, feeling for it, is beaten on the inside
back of a length outside off. Pant goes back and defends
back of a length on middle and leg. Pant swipes at it and the ball pings off the back leg into the on side
back of a length on middle and leg. Pant works it towards deep mid wicket. Sarfaraz moves to his left, fumbles and ends up conceding the second

goes a mile up, and taken, eventually! Googly on a fullish length outside off. Pooran gets down on one knee and tries to smash it into the Bay of Bengal. Gets under it too much, though, and the ball hangs in the air for an eternity. Sarfaraz settles under it at deep mid wicket and does enough. Nearly made a meal of it, but emerged with the ball and with his smile intact. Vital wicket for CSK!
pushed in full outside leg. Inglis looks for the reverse and scuffs it into the off side
full outside off. Poorna gets onto the front foot and pushes it towards extra cover
speared in full on the pads. Inglis rolls his wrists and tucks it off his toes towards deep backward square leg

well well! Gets the slower ball wrong and this lands almost on the adjacent strip on the off side. Inglis was shaping for the reverse-lap but let it go eventually. There is a check to see if this landed on the cut strip. Well inside, in fact, so it will just be a wide
Inglis makes Kamboj pay! Another slot ball outside off. Inglis gives himself room, opens his bat face and carves it over point!
up and over! Right in the slot on middle and off, and Inglis does not miss out. He plants his front foot and thumps it over mid off. And looks like Kamboj has overstepped too. Oh dear...
back of a length on middle and off. Inglis shuffles across, shaping for the scoop but does not make contact. A rare occasion where Inglis has not gotten the purchase he wants
short ball to welcome the new batter. Pooran jumps up onto his toes and tugs it enough to mid on's left to get off the mark

Kamboj breaks through, and the crowd comes to life! Back of a length, slanting into middle and leg. Marsh looks to go downtown but shanks it a touch off the inside half. Brevis, stood at long on, takes it and then does a little juggling act without ever going out of bounds. Better to be safe than sorry, and Marsh has to depart for a run-a-ball 10!
fired in full on the pads and for a change, Inglis does not make contact. Struck on the pad and the ball dribbles into the off side

this is a batting clinic! Feels like a net session for Inglis too! He is picking his spot and hitting it wherever HE wants to hit it too. Fullish just outside leg. He dances down and crashes it over extra cover!
going, going, gone! Marginally short on the stumps and that is all Inglis needs. He rocks back and hammers it a mile over deep mid wicket!
fortune favouring the brave! Darted in on a back of a length on leg. Inglis looks for the pick-up pull and gets an inside edge that races away past short fine leg!

this is another tremendous shot, and some way to get to a 17-ball fifty! Stunning, stunning display, and he has punctuated that landmark with something just as impressive. Backs away to this length ball outside off and caresses it over mid off!
back of a length on middle and off. Marsh goes back and knocks it to long off
no stopping this! Full just outside off and Inglis takes full toll. He goes dead-straight and razes it past mid off!
much, much fuller on middle and off. Inglis comes forward and drives it straight to mid off
stand and deliver, and there is stunned silence at Chepauk! Shortish just outside off and this sits up. Inglis stands tall and pounds it over mid on!
shortish just outside leg. Inglis has a mow across the line and misses, with the ball pinging off his body into the off side

this reverse-scoop is working a charm for Inglis, and CSK have no answers! Pushed in full on middle and off. Inglis gets into position for the reverse-scoop and helps it over short third. Just a four this time!
too easy for Inglis! Banged in and the width is the problem here. Inglis rides the bounce and cracks it through point!
shortish on leg. Inglis hops around his crease and tucks it off his hips towards deep square leg
wow. Just wow! Back of a length in the channel. Inglis pre-meditates the reverse ramp again and smokes it over the deep third fence!

a touch on the shorter side again, slanting into middle and leg. Inglis heaves it behind square and calls for two. Has to scramble and overcomes his bat getting stuck in the turf just before the crease. A direct hit and he was short!
shortish on off and this seems to skid through a touch. Bowled at 133.8kph and Inglis, swiping across the line, only connects with fresh air
hard length, nipping into off. Marsh dangles his bat and the ball rolls off the splice into the on side
hello Kamboj, says Marsh! This is another serious stroke. On a length on middle and off. Marsh stands tall, goes through the line and slams it over mid on!
back of a length outside off and this skids through. Inglis shapes for the cut but is beaten for pacce
my word, Josh Inglis! Back of a length outside off. Inglis pre-empts the line, unleashes the reverse-lap and nails it over slip!
on the shorter side, outside off. Marsh stays back and pushes it towards cover point, where Sarfaraz, on as a sub, misfields and ends up conceding a run
fullish on middle and off, swinging in again. Marsh gets a half stride in and pokes it into the off side
oh! This is a brutish delivery. Shortish on off and shaping in viciously. Marsh is nearly cut in half and the ball grazes the back thigh on its way to the keeper
back of a length outside off. Marsh throws his hands at it and drills it towards backward point. Marsh will feel he missed out there
oh dear - this is a wild delivery. So short outside off that Mukesh's toenails were in danger for a moment. Well outside off and called a wide
four more, and Inglis has won this first round comprehensively! A bit of a drag-down on middle and off. Inglis rocks back and pounds it to mid on's right!
Inglis' attack continues! Angled in on a length on middle and leg. Inglis gets inside the line, gets down on one knee and lifts it over short fine!
easy as you like! Floated up into the slot on middle and off. Inglis presses forward, holds his shape and eases it over the bowler's head!
back of a length just outside off. Holds and straightens a touch, and Marsh, hanging back, punches it down to long off
back of a length on leg. Marsh goes back and helps it round the corner behind square
shortish and angling into middle and off. Holds a little in the surface and Inglis tugs it to deep mid wicket

bam - Dube needs all of two balls in the final over, and CSK have sealed a 200-plus chase for the first time in an eternity! Back of a length just outside off. Dube gets his front foot out of the way and clobbers it over deep mid wicket. A clean strike to finish what had become a very scratchy run-chase towards the end, but CSK, having now gotten over the line, might not care much about it. CSK move up to 12 points, and LSG meander to the brink of elimination!
Dube swings for the hills, and Dube lands a body blow! Just what he was waiting for. On a length outside off. Dube lines it up and clatters it a mile over long on. Dube has found his range. Finally!
this is hung up full and wide again, and it spins beyond the tramlines. Dube shoulders arms again and the wide is called
darted across a mile outside off. Left alone by the batter and the umpire has to indulge in some exercise
full ball on the pads and Dube cannot get this away either. He swings hard at it and hoicks it towards fine leg. Keeps strike too
zinged in very full on the pads. Veer tucks it away towards deep backward square leg
pick that one out from the stands, says Prashant Veer! And Chepauk heaves a collective sigh of relief. Right in the slot on the stumps. Veer plants his front foot and wallops it over long on!

rapped on the pad, but this may have pitched outside leg! Zipped in very full, perhaps pitching just outside leg. Dube plays all around it and gets struck on the back leg. Ball rolls away towards short third for a run. And it looks like LSG, almost as an afterthought, have reviewed. No bat involved but Ball Tracking, as expected, shows the ball to be pitching outside leg. Dube survives!
full ball speared in well down leg. Dube does not fiddle with it and the umpire has no qualms in calling it a wide

dropped again - and this is now becoming contagious! In the slot outside off. Veer winds up and swings at it but chunks it off the inside half of the bat. Pooran runs in from deep mid wicket, dives forward but the ball pops out as his elbows hit the deck!

Rathi drops another absolute soda, and you can sense the steam coming out of Avesh's ears! Low full toss outside off. Veer shuffles across and looks for the scoop. Clinks it off the toe-end and Rathi makes a meal of it at short fine leg!
banged in short on middle and leg. Veer gets into a tangle initially but adjusts in the end to glide it down to deep third. Keeps strike too
very full outside off. Veer cannot get under this and scuffs it towards extra cover
banged in short outside off. Dube stands up on his toes and dabs it towards sweeper cover
slower ball dug in short outside off. Veer jumps up onto his toes and dabs it down to deep third
oh wow - Veer rises to the occasion with a big shot! Full on middle and leg, and this is in the slot. Veer snaps his wrists into action and whips it over deep square leg!
shortish on leg, and this skids through too. Veer has a tug at it and misses with the ball pinging into his thigh pad. Muted lbw appeal but that may have pitched outside leg
back of a length on off, and this skids through. Veer, looking to work to leg, gets a scratch on it before the ball rolls away behind point off the pad
hard length, zinging into middle and off. Veer gets up on his toes and plays it back to the bowler
short ball but this too slides down leg. Veer gets inside the line and the umpire has no qualms in calling it a wide
hard length again, angling into off. Dube pokes it into the mid wicket region and gets off the mark at the second time of asking
hard length on middle and leg. Dube sits back in his crease and defends it towards the bowler
banged in short outside leg and this sails over Dube's head. Called a wide
shortish on middle and off. Veer, a little rushed on the pull, hacks it down to fine leg

straight down deep point's throat, and LSG are turning this around! Short, wide and there to be hit. Kartik absolutely laces it but he does not get under it enough, nor does he find the gap. Could not have picked out the sweeper even if he wanted, and CSK in a bit of a pickle now!

does him all ends up, and Brevis bites the dust too! Another googly and this is nicely tossed up outside off. Brevis' eyes light up and he looks ot slog it into next week. Loses his shape completely and does not pick the googly either. Fresh-air swing, and the ball rattles into off stump. LSG turning the screw!
googly on a back of a length just outside off. Brevis hangs back and chops it off his stumps towards short third
fullish outside off. Kartik goes back and across before poking it into the cover point region
flighted up full outside off. Kartik looks to go downtown but ends up shanking it off the inside edge into his pads
shortish again, and spinning into the hips, Brevis works it towards deep mid wicket
shortish and following the batter outside leg. Brevis tugs it enough to deep mid wicket's left and picks up a brace
back of a length on middle and leg. Brevis, tucked up for room, pushes it towards deep mid wicket and keeps strike
angled in full outside off. Kartik gets onto the front foot and drives it uppishly towards long on
clever batting! Back of a length just outside off. Kartik shimmies across, drops down to one knee and scoops it between short fine and the keeper!

pace-on bumper on off, and this flies through. Brevis is incredibly late on the pull and Pant does well to get something on it. Called a wide on height, a little belatedly, and Pant's fumble allowed Kartik to pinch a bye too
slower short ball outside off. Brevis jumps up onto his toes and tries the upper-cut, but only swishes at thin air

Prince appeals for a catch off the boot, and we go upstairs to check! Sizzling yorker on middle and off. Brevis has a stab at it and chunks it off the inside edge. The ball comes off the boot but did it hit the boot on the full? Nope, it did not. Clearly a bump ball, and Brevis stays!
length just outside off. Brevis gets onto the front foot and drives it on the up to extra cover

Pant pleads and pleads and pleads, but the umpire says no! LSG review! Fizzed through on a back of a length. Pitches outside off and spins back in sharply. Kartik, having advanced, plays all over it and gets pinged on the back leg, right in front of middle. Was it doing too much? Ball Tracking says it was. Spinning down leg is the verdict, and Kartik survives!
back of a length outside off. Brevis goes back and jabs it towards short third
another googly but this slides down leg. Brevis does not get bat on it and the wide has not been called either. Might have brushed the pad on the way
googly flighted up full outside off. Kartik plants his front foot and drills it towards long on
angled in full on leg stump. Brevis comes onto the front foot and eases it to long on
back of a length on middle and off. Kartik hangs back and stabs it to long on
oh, hello! Floated up full on middle and leg. Brevis plants his front foot and pumps it over the bowler's head. Well, that is one way to announce your arrival!

castled, and the CSK skipper has to go! Fired through on a length on middle and off. Gaikwad shapes for the pull but this is perhaps too full to be playing that stroke. Rushed on the shot completely and the ball breezes past his bat before smashing into the stumps. Gaikwad is distraught as he walks off, and this is a timely breakthrough for LSG!
right in the gap! On a length outside off. Gaikwad gets down on one knee and pings a sweep between deep mid wicket and deep square leg!
full on leg. Kartik presses forward and pokes it down the ground
shortish outside off. Gaikwad gives himself room and cuts it towards backward point, who flies to his left and saves three
fullish just outside off. Kartik gets onto the front foot and knocks it to long off
just over! Short and wide. Kartik throws his hands at it and cuts it just beyond a leaping backward point. Raghuwanshi may have gotten a hand to it
low full toss just outside off. Flicked down the ground to long on
back of a length just outside off. Kartik jabs it to mid on and darts across to the other end
another sharp short ball, on off. Kartik just about gets on top of it and bunts it towards deep mid wicket. Scrambles back for two as well
short again, outside off. Kartik jumps up into the air and swishes himself off his feet. Still fails to make contact
fullish just outside off. Gaikwad gets onto the front foot and pokes it towards long on
shortish on middle and leg. Gaikwad picks it up and pulls it on the bounce to deep backward square leg
leg-cutter on a back of a length outside off. Gaikwad waits for it before jabbing it to extra cover
short, wide and no need for reviews this time. Gaikwad lets it go and the umpire has to indulge in some more exercise
dug in short on off. Kartik sits deep in his crease before swatting it to deep mid wicket
angled in on a length on the pads. Gaikwad flicks it towards deep mid wicket
back of a length outside off. Kartik drops it into the off side and hares across to the other end

short outside off and this balloons past the batter. Left alone and called a wide. But LSG think it is not a wide and they review. The top of Kartik's head is measured at 1.79m, and the ball is passing through at 1.79m. The graphic says it is 'above head', but the third umpire says it is not. Decision overturned!
shortish outside off. Kartik hangs back and chops it towards sweeper cover
given a bit of air, on a full length just outside off. Kartik drives it enough to long off's left and canters back for a couple of runs
darted in full on the pads. Gaikwad tucks it towards deep mid wicket
tossed up full outside off. Kartik comes forward and pokes it past the bowler. A bit of a misfield and the youngster gets off the mark

slapped straight to deep extra cover, and Chepauk, after the initial shock, stands as one to applaud an all-timer knock! Hung up on a length wide outside off. Urvil looks to smash it inside-out but does not get the elevation he wants. Hits it flat but also straight to Avesh, who stoops down low and sends Urvil on his way. Stunning, stunning knock, though, and it has put CSK right on track!
tossed up full on leg. Gaikwad gets onto the front foot and pushes it towards deep mid wicket
almost a wicket! Slower bumper outside off. Urvil tries to tonk this into tomorrow and loses all shape. Nearly drags it onto his stumps
back of a length on middle and leg. Gaikwad uses the angle and glances it behind square
safe! Shortish on middle and off, and this hurries onto the batter too. Gets big on Urvil as he shapes to pull and he shanks it into the vacant mid wicket region

dropped - oh dear! Rathi has dropped an absolute sitter! Banged in again, outside off. Urvil way too early on the pull and the ball clinks off the toe-end towards backward point. The simplest of catches and Rathi shells it. Has he dropped this game?
pace-on, short and wide outside off. Skips off the surface and Urvil, jumping into the air and swishing at it, is beaten for pace
slower ball bashed into the track outside off. Urvil is too early into his swipe and shanks it to the bowler's right
slowed up and hung up on a length wide outside off. Urvil loses his shape and swings too hard. Ends up dragging it to deep mid wicket
flighted up full on middle and off. Gaikwad comes onto the front foot and works it towards deep mid wicket
back of a length outside off. Gaikwad looks to dab it away and seems to get a scratch. Pant cannot gather, though
back of a length outside off. Urvil waits on it and slaps it towards deep cover

a whip of the wrists, and more catching practice in the crowd! Shades of another wicket-keeper who plays for CSK. Full on leg. Urvil moves across and with a swish of the bat, pummels it over deep square leg!
that has gone to the fence like a....well, you know what comes after it! Back of a length outside off. Sits up and Urvil goes through the line, blasting it over extra cover!

a 13-ball fifty for Urvil Patel! Take a bow, and this is the joint-fastest fifty in IPL history! Back of a length outside off. Urvil taps it into the point region and that is the crowd's cue to stand up and applaud (not that they have not been on their feet throughout). Brings out a chit from his pocket (although not sure what was written on it), and this has been an innings and some. An innings that will live long in the memory of those who have watched it. Staggering. Just staggering!
zipped in full on middle and off. Gaikwad tucks it off his pads towards deep mid wicket
back of a length outside off. Gaikwad dinks it into the point region and has enough energy and time to hurtle back for two
back of a length outside off. Urvil gets up on his toes and dabs it behind point. Just a single and a hush descends around Chepauk
kaboom! Watch that fly too! Slower ball that lands right in the slot outside off. Urvil winds up and thumps it over long on!
off-pace and into the track outside off. Urvil has a wild whoosh at it and only grabs a handful of fresh air
shortish outside off. Urvil opens up his stance and heaves it towards deep mid wicket. Just a single and that feels like an anti-climax
oh good lord - what has Urvil had for lunch?! Right in the slot on middle and off. Urvil gets his front foot out of the way and mooses it over deep mid wicket!
over the off side now! Pushed across the batter on a full length outside off. Urvil throws the plumbing at it and scythes it over cover!
oh my goodness - this is awesome ball-striking! Slightly floaty and definitely in the slot on leg. Urvil gets down on one knee and clubs it over deep mid wicket!
speared a mile down leg and Pant does very well to get to it. Just a solitary wide
make that four sixes in a row for Urvil Patel! Angled in full just outside leg. Urvil gives himself swinging room and smokes it over long on!
back of a length just outside off. Gaikwad drops it into the off side and gets Urvil back on strike
fetch that one from the stands too, says Urvil! Another off-pace length delivery and Urvil reads this like the morning daily. He swings at it with all his might and whacks it over deep mid wicket!
this is another thunderous blow! Slower ball dug in short outside off and this sits up outside off. Urvil lines it up and bulldozes it flat over the wide long on fence!
right out of the screws! Back of a length on off. Urvil picks the length early and wallops it off the front foot over cow corner!
on a length outside off. Gaikwad dabs it with soft hands behind point and picks up another single
back of a length outside off. Holds a little in the surface and Gaikwad, trying to force it through the off side, nearly chops it onto his stumps
welcomed with a flat six! Half-tracker outside off and Gaikwad feasts. He stands tall and obliterates it over the wide long on fence!
fullish outside off. Gaikwad lunges forward and taps it gently into the off side to retain strike
carrom ball on a length outside off. Urvil comes forward and punches it to mid off to open his account

dragged down, and through'im! Samson cannot believe it, and thousands in yellow cannot either! Short on off and this is there to be hit too. Samson lines up the mid wicket region but swings at it way too early. Misses the ball altogether and off stump is knocked back. Rathi with a pivotal breakthrough, and Samson has to go for a 14-ball 28!
this is beautiful! A little slower but in the slot just outside off. Samson's languid bat swing flows through the ball and he launches this clean over long off!
up and over this time! Carrom ball on a back of a length on middle and off. Samson gives himself enough room and bangs it over mid off!
fired in on a back of a length on the stumps. Samson pushes it off the back foot towards mid off
dispatched! Marginally short outside off and Gaikwad climbs into it. He stands up on his toes, gets his front hip out of the way and hammers it through mid wicket!
angled in on a length on middle and off. Gaikwad presses half forward and pats it to mid wicket
safe! Full and wide outside off. Samson backs away and throws his hands at it. Slices it a touch and the ball dribbles to deep backward point
gorgeous! Back of a length outside off. Samson rises with the bounce, goes through the line and pops it nonchalantly over mid off!
back of a length on middle and off. Samson opens up his stance and swipes at it. Misses it completely and is lucky his off stump is not sent tumbling!
back of a length on middle and leg. Samson stays back and pokes it towards mid wicket
on a length wide outside off. Gaikwad gets half forward and jabs it towards cover point
back of a length outside off. Gaikwad gets up on his toes and plays it back to the bowler
Gaikwad joins in on the six-hitting fun too! Banged into the track on middle and leg. Gaikwad gets inside the line, gets under it and hooks it over the fine leg fence!
slanted in on a length on middle and leg. Gaikwad gets a half stride in and bunts it into the vacant mid wicket region. Back for a brace
back of a length on the hips. Samson lets the ball arrive before tucking it behind square
picked up and dumped into the stands! A touch short on middle and that is all Samson needs. He swivels and sends it soaring over mid wicket!
back of a length outside off. Samson opens his bat face and runs it down to deep backward point
full and shaping in, finishing just outside off. Gaikwad comes half forward and stabs it hurriedly towards mid on
off the mark in style! Shortish again and Gaikwad cashes in on the width. He chops his cut into the turf and the ball bounces up over the off-side ring!
shortish outside off. Samson gets on top of the bounce and jabs it towards backward point, who fumbles and allows Samson to get off strike
Samson off the mark! Shortish and sliding down leg. Samson gets inside the line and helps it fine past the keeper!
back of a length outside off and this shapes away. Samson hangs back and chalks it into the off side
